description: During the same EVA sent to recover the Sol 7 mud-mired ATV (FMARS-C19-2026-EVT006), a second, separate ATV broke down at the same location.
source_citation: SRC-fmars-c19-2026-mission-updates, sol-8 report. Commander's 'thorn': 'Finding out that we rescued an ATV just to lose another ATV, in the exact same place.' Corroborated by the Science Officer's (FMARS-C19-2026-CM03) petal/thorn the same day: 'We recovered a rover, that was pretty good... We lost a rover, that was pretty bad.'
